items.title: T Mobile US (TMUS) Stock Looks Reasonable Despite Its 38% Five Year Return
items.summary: T-Mobile US has seen a mixed share price story, with the stock giving back ground over the past year after a longer multi year climb. That puts fresh focus on whether the current valuation is still supported by its earnings power. With new telecom partnerships and shareholder return decisions in the headlines, the question now is what investors are really paying for in those earnings at today’s price.
